entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Kobroor is an island in the Aru Islands in the Arafura Sea. It is situated in the Maluku Province, Indonesia. Its area is 1723 km2. The other main islands in the archipelago are Tanahbesar, Kola, Maikoor, Koba and Trangan.
